insurer: ICICI Lombard General Insurance Company Limited
sumInsured: Not specified (varies by plan; room rent terms differ for up to ₹4L vs ₹5L+)

great.name: Room rent: No capping for SI ₹5 lakhs and above (default term is SI-dependent)
great.quote: For policies with Annual Sum Insured options Rs. 5 Lakhs and above, there will be no room rent capping.
great.reference: Benefits covered under the Policy > Basic cover > In-patient Treatment > i. Room Rent charges
great.explanation: If you choose ₹5L+ Sum Insured, room rent is at actuals (no cap), avoiding room-rent linked deductions.

great.name: Restore/Reset benefit: 100% reset for any illness/injury (incl. unlimited resets for SI ₹10L+)
great.quote: We will reset up to 100% of the Annual Sum Insured, for any illness/disease/injury... For policies with annual sum insured Rs. 10 Lakhs and above reset benefit will be triggered unlimited times for any illness/disease/injury
great.reference: Benefits covered under the Policy > Basic cover > 8. Reset Benefit
great.explanation: Provides a strong restore buffer after the base sum insured is exhausted (subject to stated conditions; for ₹10L+ it can be unlimited in a year).

great.name: Built-in additional Sum Insured buffer: Loyalty bonus usable after base SI exhausts (non-claim-linked reduction protected)
great.quote: We will provide a Loyalty bonus of 20%... at the end of each Policy Year irrespective of a claim being initiated... Loyalty bonus can only be utilized when the Annual Sum Insured is completely exhausted... In the event of Claim... the credited Loyalty bonus will not be reduced.
great.reference: Benefits covered under the Policy > 17. Loyalty bonus
great.explanation: Extra coverage builds up even if you claim, and once base SI is fully used, the bonus can fund additional eligible expenses.

great.name: Bariatric surgery covered (with eligibility & 24-month waiting)
great.quote: 7. Bariatric Surgery Cover We will cover medical expenses incurred in respect of Hospitalisation... for Surgical Procedure/treatment for Obesity... This benefit has a waiting period of 24 months from date of inception of the first policy with Us
great.reference: Benefits covered under the Policy > Basic cover > 7. Bariatric Surgery Cover
great.explanation: Obesity surgery is covered if BMI/clinical criteria are met and waiting period is completed.

great.name: Modern treatments/technological advancements covered (listed) up to SI
great.quote: We will cover the Medical Expenses... for the below mentioned Technological Advancements and Treatments... up to the Annual Sum Insured.
great.reference: Benefits covered under the Policy > Basic cover > 3. Technological Advancements and Treatments
great.explanation: Covers several modern procedures (e.g., robotic surgeries, immunotherapy injections, deep brain stimulation) without any sub-limit stated in the quoted clause.

great.name: NCB / Renewal bonus does not reset on claims (Loyalty bonus irrespective of claims)
great.quote: We will provide a Loyalty bonus of 20%... irrespective of a claim being initiated in the Policy Year... In the event of Claim... the credited Loyalty bonus will not be reduced.
great.reference: Benefits covered under the Policy > 17. Loyalty bonus
great.explanation: Unlike typical NCBs that reduce/reset after claims, this renewal bonus continues and is not reduced due to claims (subject to continuous renewal).

good.name: PED waiting period: 0 or 24 months (plan-dependent)
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of a pre-existing Disease (PED)... shall be excluded until the expiry of 0 Months/24 months (depending on plan opted) of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first policy
good.reference: Exclusions > Standard Exclusions > 1. Pre-Existing Diseases - Code- Excl01
good.explanation: PED waiting is either 0 months or 24 months based on plan chosen—both are good in market terms (0 months is excellent, 24 months is standard-good).

good.name: Specific disease/procedure waiting period: 0 or 24 months (plan-dependent)
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of the listed Conditions... shall be excluded until the expiry of 0 months/24months (depending on plan opted)
good.reference: Exclusions > Standard Exclusions > 2. Specified Disease/Procedure Waiting Period- Code- Excl02
good.explanation: Specific disease waiting is up to 24 months depending on plan, which is standard.

good.name: Initial waiting period: 30 days
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of any illness within 30 days from the first policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an accident
good.reference: Exclusions > Standard Exclusions > 4. 30-day waiting period- Code- Excl03
good.explanation: 30-day initial waiting is standard for health insurance.

good.name: Pre-hospitalization cover: 60 days
good.quote: We will cover the Pre-hospitalization Medical Expenses... immediately 60 days before the Insured Person’s Admission to Hospital
good.reference: Benefits covered under the Policy > Basic cover > 4. Pre- Hospitalisation Medical Expenses
good.explanation: Covers eligible expenses for 60 days before admission (standard-good).

good.name: Post-hospitalization cover: 180 days
good.quote: We will cover the Post-hospitalization Medical Expenses... immediately 180 days following the Insured Person’s discharge from Hospital
good.reference: Benefits covered under the Policy > Basic cover > 5. Post Hospitalization Medical Expenses
good.explanation: Covers eligible expenses up to 180 days after discharge (standard-good).

good.name: Air ambulance (domestic) covered (limit not explicitly capped in this clause; subject to SI & conditions)
good.quote: We will cover the expenses incurred on Air Ambulance services up to the Annual Sum Insured...
good.reference: Benefits covered under the Policy > Basic cover > 10. Domestic Air Ambulance Cover
good.explanation: Domestic air ambulance is available for life-threatening emergencies under stated conditions.

good.name: Domiciliary hospitalization covered (with min 3 days condition and listed ailment exclusions)
good.quote: We will cover the Medical Expenses incurred in respect of the Domiciliary Hospitalization... continues for at least 3 consecutive days
good.reference: Benefits covered under the Policy > Basic cover > 12. Domiciliary Hospitalization
good.explanation: Home-based hospitalization is covered when hospital shifting/bed unavailability criteria apply, but with conditions and a list of non-payable ailments under this section.

bad.name: Room rent cap for SI up to ₹4 lakhs (1% of Annual Sum Insured)
bad.quote: For policies with Annual Sum Insured options up to Rs. 4 Lakhs- room rent charges shall be capped at 1 % of Annual Sum Insured
bad.reference: Benefits covered under the Policy > Basic cover > In-patient Treatment > i. Room Rent charges
bad.explanation: A percentage-based room rent cap can force you into lower rooms and may trigger proportionate deductions if you choose a higher room.

bad.name: Proportionate deduction applies when room category exceeds entitlement
bad.quote: If the Insured Person is admitted in a room category/limit that is higher than the one that is specified... then the Insured Person shall bear a rateable proportion of the total Associated medical expenses
bad.reference: Benefits covered under the Policy > Basic cover > In-patient Treatment > We will consider a claim under this Cover, subject to the following:
bad.explanation: If your room is above eligibility (relevant when there is a room limit/cap), insurer can reduce payable associated medical expenses proportionately.

bad.name: Consumables not fully covered (non-medical items list excluded; out-of-pocket likely)
bad.quote: consumables (other than those specified in the list of excluded expenses (non-medical) in Annexure II.
bad.reference: Benefits covered under the Policy > Basic cover > In-patient Treatment > v.
bad.explanation: Many consumable/non-medical items in Annexure II are not payable, which can increase out-of-pocket (gloves, masks, kits, etc. appear in the non-payable list).

bad.name: No restore/Reset for same illness relapse within 45 days (same insured person) in same policy year
bad.quote: The Reset Benefit will not be available for an Illness /Injury or related complications including but not limited to any relapse within 45 days in respect of which a claim has been paid in that Policy Year for the same Insured Person
bad.reference: Benefits covered under the Policy > Basic cover > 8. Reset Benefit > viii
bad.explanation: Reset cannot be used for the same illness/relapse within 45 days in the same policy year for the same person, reducing usefulness for repeat admissions for same condition.

bad.name: Disease-wise 90-day exclusion for Hypertension/Diabetes/Cardiac conditions (unless already continuously covered >12 months)
bad.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of the below mentioned illness within 90 days from the first policy commencement date shall be excluded... i. Hypertension ii. Diabetes iii. Cardiac Conditions
bad.explanation: Creates an additional early waiting/exclusion for common lifestyle conditions beyond the basic 30-day waiting.

bad.name: No NCB if policy not continuously renewed (bonus not credited; accrual requires renewal within grace)
bad.quote: Loyalty bonus will not be added if the Policy is not renewed with the Company by the end of the Grace Period
bad.reference: Benefits covered under the Policy > 17. Loyalty bonus > iii
bad.explanation: If renewal is delayed beyond grace, you lose the continuity and loyalty bonus credit.

bad.name: Claim notification delay can make claim inadmissible (insurer discretion)
bad.quote: The above information needs to be provided... within 10 days of Hospitalisation, failing which We will have the right to treat the Claim as inadmissible, as We may deem fit at Our sole discretion.
bad.reference: Claims Procedure > (B) For Reimbursement Settlement > i.
bad.explanation: Late claim intimation (for reimbursement route) can risk denial at insurer discretion; operationally important to comply.
